title: India To Get AI Law, Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw Says Centre Will Issue Consultation Paper Soon
hook_text: India is drafting new AI laws
script:
India is drafting a formal legal framework for AI.
Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw confirmed the Centre will issue a consultation paper soon.
The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology will lead this public consultation process.
This move follows global efforts to regulate AI safety and algorithmic accountability.
Would you support strict government oversight for all AI models?
